УКО®

COMMERCIAL

May 15, 2018

To Our Valued Customers:

Price Increase Notice SBS Products & Protectoboard Products Effective: June 15th, 2018

Due to the increase in manufacturing costs we are announcing a price increase on all SBS products & Protectoboard products.

Effective June 15th, 2018 the following increases will go into effect

All SBS products will increase between 5% and 8% All Protectoboard products will increase by 5% All orders currently in house will be protected at current pricing. Any new order that remain unshipped by June 15th 2018, regardless of order date, will be invoiced at the new pricing.

Should you have any questions or require further clarification, please do not hesitate to contact your local IKO representative.

We thank you for your continued support of IKO Products.

Sincerely, IKO INDUSTRIES LTD.

Akif Amin Vice President - Commercial Division

87 ORENDA ROAD, BRAMPTON, ONTARIO L6W 1V7 TEL. (905) 457-5321 FAX: (905) 796-0074
